{{Quote|I'd turn back, friends. You're headed for professionals now&mdash;not everyday thugs.|Vilus Garr|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vilus Garr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who was hired by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[conquest of Makeb]] to lead the [[Army/Legends|armies]] gathering on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darvannis]]. Garr used a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]] and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in combat. However, Garr and the other three warlords&mdash;[[Sunder (mercenary)|Sunder]], [[Horic]], and [[Tu'chuk]]&mdash;were unknowingly hired by the [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Styrak]] and not the Cartel. The four warlords were [[Death/Legends|slain]] before Styrak's plans could advance beyond Darvannis.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vilus Garr appears as one of the Four Warlords, who collectively appear as the sixth and penultimate boss in the "Scum and Villainy" Operation. The Operation was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2012]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'',<ref name="TOR" /> and defeating the Warlords in various difficulty modes rewards players with painting-like trophies of the Warlords for use in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']].<ref name="GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref>
